phases.objective: Make SHA-scoped generated-artifact convergence resilient to GitHub ref visibility delay without weakening exact-head CAS, protected-branch rejection, writer authority, or generated-state governance.

e2e_journeys.actor: trusted generated-artifact dispatcher and sole governed generated-state writer
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: workflow_dispatch of governed-generated-artifact-refresh.yml with an exact non-protected target ref and, for post-merge convergence, create_from_main=true plus an exact source_main_sha
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A truly absent SHA-scoped branch is created from exact current main, transient post-create ref invisibility is retried within a bounded backoff window, any visible wrong SHA fails closed immediately, non-404 lookup errors are never treated as absence, and early failures still publish bounded non-secret preflight evidence.
steps: Initialize the bounded evidence directory and a non-secret preflight record before dispatch validation or branch preparation can fail.
Validate trusted-writer mode, exact expected SHA, registered recipe, typed confirmation, and protected-branch rejection.
For create_from_main, require current main, source_main_sha, and expected_head_sha to be identical before branch mutation.
Read the target ref and interpret absence only when the GitHub API explicitly reports HTTP 404 or Not Found; fail closed on every other lookup error.
When the ref is absent, create it at the exact expected SHA and validate the create response when GitHub returns success.
Whether creation succeeds or races with another idempotent creator, perform at most eight backoff readbacks and continue only after the remote ref resolves to the exact expected SHA.
Reject immediately if a visible target ref resolves to any SHA other than expected_head_sha.
Delegate deterministic generated-state mutation and exact-head verification through the existing registered writer paths without force push or protected-branch mutation.
assertions: main and Production remain forbidden mutation targets.
A non-404 target-ref lookup failure cannot be converted into an inferred missing branch.
Post-create readback is bounded to eight attempts with backoff and cannot spin indefinitely.
An existing or newly visible target ref at the wrong SHA fails closed rather than being moved or force-updated.
A create API collision or transient create error is accepted only if subsequent bounded remote readback proves the exact expected SHA.
The evidence directory exists before mutable preflight and records remote_write_executed=false and secrets_included=false.
Generated artifacts remain owned by registered writers; this contract does not authorize hand-edited generated outputs.
No deployment, migration apply, grant, provider mutation, live database mutation, credential payload read, direct Production write, or force push is authorized.

phases.objective: Observe an exact-main convergence run create or reuse its SHA-scoped branch and complete writer verification with the hardened readback logic active.

Exercise delayed ref visibility, a concurrent idempotent create collision, a non-404 lookup error, a visible wrong SHA, and readback exhaustion while preserving fail-closed behavior and bounded evidence.
Repository ref convergence performs no live provider or deployment canary.
This writer is prohibited from mutating Production and the hardening grants no deployment authority.
